details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a small JSON record to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc containing the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the working directory and the npm user-agent, with an x-beacon-package header. The same beacon also fires when index.js is required; index.js otherwise exports a no-op Proxy so importing code does not crash. No credentials, environment values, tokens or file contents are collected or transmitted, and nothing else is executed.
